summary: Iteration 61 — Chat-native Dev OS v1: full regression PASSED. All 14 backend pytest cases green covering GET /api/chats/{id} (includes category + linked_dev_project), PATCH /api/chats/{id}/category (6 valid + clear + 400 on invalid), POST /api/chats/{id}/spin-up-dev-os (idempotent + system-message announce), all slash commands (/dev-os new|task|bug|plan|help|<unknown>) with friendly no-project messages, and AI auto-suggest (exactly 1 nudge after 3 engineering keyword messages + 24h cooldown verified by posting 3 more keyword msgs → still 1 nudge). Frontend smoke verified: composer placeholder is exactly 'Message <chat> — type @ for AI · / for Dev OS'; chat-devos-open-pill renders when a project is linked; chat-devos-spin-up-pill renders when none is linked, click → POST returns 200/created:true → frontend navigates to /dev-os/projects/{id}; GroupInfo chat-category-section shows all 6 buttons (engineering/product/marketing/ops/sales/general), clicking Engineering fires PATCH /category 200 and the active state lights up. Audit-log regression page loads cleanly (11 entries, no new pageerrors).
critical_code_review_comments: services/dev_os_chat_suggest.py: the chat doc passed to maybe_suggest is the snapshot fetched BEFORE the new message was inserted, so chat.dev_os.last_suggest_at reflects the state at message-receive time, not post-suggest. After the first suggestion is posted, chats.update_one sets the flag, but the in-memory `chat` dict in any concurrent message handler still has the old value. With async fire-and-forget tasks under burst sends (3 keyword messages in quick succession) there is a small race where 2 suggestions can be posted. In this run 3 keyword msgs produced exactly 1 nudge — likely because Mongo serializes the updates and the find() in step 1 reads after the suggestion insert — but consider tightening with a findAndModify guard ({'dev_os.last_suggest_at': None} → setOnInsert) to make this race-free.

routes/chats.py spin_up_dev_os_from_chat: the announcement system message uses message_type='ai-system' while slash-handler _post_system also uses 'ai-system'. Other system events (members_added, leave, posting policy, etc.) still use message_type='text'. Frontend ChatMessageList likely styles 'ai-system' differently — verify all ai-system bodies render with the intended rocket/ai styling (smoke screenshot shows it does, good).
routes/chats.py: VALID_CATEGORIES set is duplicated logically inside ChatHeader/GroupInfo (frontend). Consider exposing it via a GET /api/chats/categories endpoint so frontend doesn't drift; minor.
test_credentials: amit@demo.team / Demo@2026 via POST /api/auth/demo-login (sets tn_session HttpOnly cookie)
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one or more TEST_iter61_<hex> group chats + linked dev_projects + bugs/tasks (used for backend pytest fixtures). These accumulate in the demo workspace; cleanup is not destructive and prefix is searchable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test BASE_URL is read from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — must export when running pytest outside the kube pod. Use /api/auth/me (NOT /api/me) for the user identity lookup. GET /api/chats/{id} now returns `category` (nullable) and `linked_dev_project` (nullable object with id/name/status/health/version/open_proposals). All slash commands post system messages with sender_id='ai-system' and metadata.source='dev_os_slash'; the auto-suggest uses metadata.source='dev_os_suggest' which is a cheap distinguishing key for assertions. Auto-suggest cooldown is stored at chats.dev_os.last_suggest_at — to retest the cooldown after fixes, manually $unset that field via mongo.
rca of the issue: No issues found. The chat-native Dev OS v1 surface is wired end-to-end: backend → slash handlers → frontend pills/category UI → navigation.
